ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio; approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels to 15% low-intensity black pixels on the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region is a contiguous high-intensity white field. Low-intensity black bands trace the trailing edge and tips. Several isolated dark circular spots (approx. 5-10 clusters) are distributed across the mid-sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped notch; inner angle approximately 60 degrees; significant depth relative to horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels along the trailing boundary, most concentrated on the distal sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves forming the trailing edges of both lobes, tapering to pointed, slightly uplifted distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple localized circular dark clusters (approx. 3-6 per lobe) scattered across the mid-latitudinal white field of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dark pigmentation cluster concentrated at the base of the median notch; irregular jagged fragmentation and edge loss on the distal end of the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive symmetrical 'eye-like' dark circular marks present on the mid-ventral surface of both lobes.
